design_vision.narrative: A dark-room editing suite built for the future. The interface drops away, letting the vibrant, cinematic video content shine. Precision meets creative freedom.
core_principles: Dark-First: True black and obsidian surfaces to reduce eye strain and make media pop.
Neon Tension: A single, high-contrast electric accent color (Volt Yellow) to guide action.
Control Room Grid: High density, rigid 1px borders, and clear hierarchy in the dashboard.
Crystal Glassmorphism: Premium floating elements over grainy cinematic backgrounds.

marketing_page.strategy: Bento layouts, heavy asymmetry, generous negative space.

dashboard.strategy: Control Room Grid. Dense, compact, every pixel utilized. Use h-full to stretch children. 1px borders to map out sections.

spacing_and_layout.borders: rounded-lg to rounded-xl (subtle roundness, max 12px for primary surfaces, sharp edges for inner widgets).

surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with a subtle border-b border-white/10.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards_dashboard: Flat background (bg-[#141416]), 1px border-white/10, no ambient shadow. Hover state: border-white/30 and subtle -translate-y-1.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.primary_button: Solid Acid Yellow (bg-[#E2FF3D]) with stark black text. No gradients. Hover: brightness increase.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.textures: Use subtle noise/grain overlays on the marketing hero section to prevent digital flatness.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactives must have clear hover states. Buttons scale up slightly, borders brighten.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Smooth fade-ins. Staggered entrance for dashboard grid items.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Use a slow, organic 'Editorial Ribbon' for the 'Trusted By' section on the landing page.

components_strategy.framework: React, Tailwind CSS, pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing, heavily customized Shadcn for dashboard.
components_strategy.icons: lucide-react (default choice) for clean, minimalist SVG icons.
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn components (Input, Select, Checkbox). Never use native HTML elements for complex inputs.
components_strategy.tables_lists: Shadcn Table with border-b border-white/10 for rows. Striped backgrounds are banned; use hover states.
components_strategy.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs). Format: kebab-case, role-based.

images.description: Atmospheric cinematic set, used as a dark ambient background behind the main hero text. Opacity 30%.
Abstract dark noise texture. Overlay on the dashboard sidebar or marketing section with mix-blend-overlay.
Professional portrait for the dashboard user profile.
Avatar for AI generated persona / team member.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. No arbitrary shades of gray.
Implement pure HTML/Tailwind for the landing page for maximum layout freedom.
Implement customized Shadcn UI for the dashboard, stripping out default light mode borders.
Ensure all `.js` files (not `.tsx`) include `data-testid` attributes on interactive elements.
Use the specific font families: Outfit (headings), Manrope (body). Add them to index.css or via Google Fonts in index.html.
NEVER use generic placeholder images (via.placeholder.com). Use the URLs provided in the media_and_assets section.
For the Video Templates and Assets Library, use a tight Bento Grid to display the content cards.
The primary CTA button must be the Volt Yellow color (#E2FF3D) with black text. Do not use generic blue or purple.
Dashboard should feature a fixed sidebar and a top sticky header with Crystal Glassmorphism.
